subject: Novacorp term refresh: alignment on timeline & exec QBR windows
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Anna Li <anna.li@novacorp.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Aug 2029 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Novacorp term refresh: alignment on timeline & exec QBR windows

Hi Anna —

Hope you’re well. Per our renewal signals last week, I wanted to kick off a short alignment thread to lock down timing, stakeholders, and next steps so we can scope the amendment and schedule the exec QBR. High-level: Novacorp’s current term ends 2029-10-31 and you indicated interest in a term refresh plus a capacity uplift for peak holiday traffic.

Proposed next steps (suggested by Redwood):
- Confirm procurement & legal contacts for contract redlines (we'll need a point person at Novacorp).
- Agree on a firm QBR week to present the proposed term/amendment and capacity plan to your execs.
- Share usage and headroom numbers we should plan for (we'll enumerate options: +25% burst, +50% committed).
- Lock an internal Redwood resource plan and pricing option to present at QBR.

Initial timeline we recommend:
- Week of 2029-08-26: internal scoping & draft mutual action plan (MAP)
- Week of 2029-09-09 OR Week of 2029-09-16: Exec QBR & contract review
- Week of 2029-09-23: Finalize amendment and DocuSign
- 2029-10-01: Capacity uplift onboarding window (if approved)

Please see attached: proposed_timeline.xlsx (overview) and mutual_action_plan.docx (draft tasks/owners). Also added a quick calendar poll to capture preferred QBR windows: https://calendar.google.com/poll/novacorp-qbr-2029 and a readout folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2bNovacorpRenewalDocs

Two asks for you to unblock scheduling this week: 1) confirm your procurement/legal contact(s); 2) flag which QBR week (9/9 or 9/16) your execs prefer.

I’ll loop in pricing and CS once we have preferred dates.

Thanks —
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Date: Wed, 14 Aug 2029 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Novacorp term refresh: alignment on timeline & exec QBR windows

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear outline. Quick answers from our side:
- Procurement/legal lead: Tom Evans (cc'd) will drive the contract side and contracts@novacorp.com will manage redlines.
- Preferred QBR week: the exec team prefers the week of 2029-09-16 (we have board prep during 9/9). Can we aim for Tue/Wed (9/17 or 9/18) in the afternoon PST?

On capacity: we are looking at a conservative +30% committed uplift with the option to burst another +20% for the holiday window, but Tom may ask for a couple of alternative pricing structures to compare (stair-step commit vs. a single uplift).

I attached our vendor requirements summary for legal to review.

Anna
Anna Li | Head of ML Platforms
Novacorp
[Attachment: novacorp_requirements.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Aug 2029 12:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Novacorp term refresh: alignment on timeline & exec QBR windows

Marissa / Kim —

Looping in a short technical note for the capacity ask. Based on Novacorp's recent token distribution and peak hour profile, +30% committed looks reasonable if we couple it with a modest KV-prefix cache for warm prompts. Pricing options to prepare for QBR:
- Option A: +30% committed at 12-month term (flat unit rate)
- Option B: Stair-step (15% + 15% mid-term with smaller initial uplift)
- Option C: Burst buffer add-on (on-demand, higher per-token during spikes)

I'll prepare a one-slide cost delta and include estimated latency impact for each option. Targeting a draft by 2029-08-28.

—Ben
Ben Carter | Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Anna Li <anna.li@novacorp.com>, Tom Evans <tevans@novacorp.com>, contracts@novacorp.com

Date: Wed, 14 Aug 2029 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Novacorp term refresh: alignment on timeline & exec QBR windows

Thanks all — great, appreciate the fast turn. Confirming next items and owners:  

1) QBR date: let's lock Tue 2029-09-17 at 1:30pm PST (proposed; Marissa to send invite). Please confirm if that slot works for Novacorp execs.
2) Contracts: Tom / contracts@novacorp.com to share any gating clauses by 2029-08-21 so our legal team can prep redlines.
3) Pricing & capacity: Ben will circulate the cost-delta slide by 2029-08-28.
4) MAP: I’ll circulate an updated mutual action plan (owners/timeboxes) by 2029-08-26 and attach the QBR deck draft to the shared Drive folder.

Attachments: qbr-readout-runbook.pdf (short checklist for the QBR: attendees, slide owners, demo notes). Also sending a DocuSign amendment link once legal aligns: https://app.docusign.com/ND-4923/amendment

If we’re all aligned I’ll publish a Google Calendar invite and a condensed agenda tomorrow.

Onwards —
Marissa
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
